question: Which Buddhist and/or Jain text gave an account of 16 Mahajanapads?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anguttara Nikaya**

 
 
• It is the** Buddhist literature** that gave an account of 16 Mahajanapads in 600 BC.
 
• The names given by the Buddhist sources are **Kasi, Kosala, Anga, Magadha, Vajji, Malla, Chedi, Vatsya, Kuru, Panchala, Matsya, Surasena, Asmaka, Avanti, Gandhara, and Kamboja.**
 
 
 
• **Bhagwati Sutra**
 
 
• It is the** Jain sutra** that gave an account of 16 Mahajanapads in 600 BC.
 
• Some Mahajanapads are **different from Buddhist literature but the list of Buddhist literature is more reliable as per historians.**
